segments.title: Chương 8: 0008 [Tăng thêm tiền]
segments.content:
After speaking individually with a few students, Liu Shuying returned to the classroom to pack her things.

"There's no school next Saturday, and there's a parent-teacher conference this weekend. Students who don't have a phone at home, remember to go back and inform your parents on Saturday…"

"There's still half an hour until the end of evening self-study. Class monitor, make sure everyone behaves!"

With that, she left.

Teachers wouldn't keep an eye on evening self-study the whole time.

Class monitor Li Rui stood up. "No talking, everyone. Please keep it quiet."

After all, it was the experimental class; they had some basic decorum.

Even students like Li Jun and Guan Zhiqiang, although they couldn't get themselves to study, wouldn't make a racket and disturb others.

At most, they would whisper to each other.

Li Jun put on his MP3 player earbuds, laid his head on his desk to listen to music, and dozed off. From time to time, he would open his eyes to look at Bian Guanyue. The more he looked, the more beautiful he found her, and he pondered how to get closer to her.

Guan Zhiqiang was still reading his novel, and drool was trickling from his mouth again without him realizing.

Xie Yang was spacing out, puffing air with his lower lip pouted to blow at the hair on his forehead for fun.

Xu Haibo seriously reviewed his English mistakes, then took out the "Denunciation of America" essay he had copied and silently pushed it in front of his deskmate, Wu Yuehan.

Wu Yuehan was a good student certain to get into a top-tier university. She read the essay carefully and asked, "You wrote this?"

They communicated silently, with lip-reading.

"It's an essay by the great hero Chen, to be submitted to New Concept," Xu Haibo replied.

He had always regarded Chen Guiliang as his idol. Whenever Chen Guiliang did something he thought was remarkable, he would proactively promote it.

Wu Yuehan praised sincerely, "So impressive. The Chinese language representative, indeed."

The two talked more and more, and lip-reading was no longer enough. Their voices gradually became audible.

Xu Haibo said, "I think the great hero Chen can win first prize. He should have entered the New Concept Composition Competition long ago."

Wu Yuehan was good at carrying a conversation. "Maybe he can even get a recommendation to a prestigious university."

Yao Lingling, who sat behind them, gently poked Wu Yuehan's shoulder with her pen. "Let me see."

Wu Yuehan passed the essay back.

Yao Lingling savored it twice, trying to learn the writing style. But this kind of semi-literary, semi-vernacular prose with balanced couplets was not something she could write. She then passed the essay to her deskmate, Wang Lei.

Wang Lei glanced at it, uninterested.

Yao Lingling then handed the essay to the adjacent desk, adding a special note, "This is the great hero Chen's New Concept submission."

In just twenty minutes, the essay had circulated through half the classroom.

Life in the third year of high school was dull and tedious. They had to find some fun for themselves, and passing around an essay was a kind of diversion.

Besides, they loved to watch Chen Guiliang stir things up.

When he demanded that the school refund the third-year computer lab fees, Li Jun was the only one in the entire class who didn't sign. In the end, they achieved their goal. The students were all very excited, feeling a sense of glory from participating in a major event.

Because of this, Chen Guiliang gained immense prestige among his classmates.

Unconsciously, the essay made its way into the hands of Wang Siyu, who sat in front of Chen Guiliang.

By this time, evening self-study was almost over. Wang Siyu turned around directly, leaned on Chen Guiliang's desk and asked, "Great hero Chen, you're entering New Concept?"

Chen Guiliang nodded. "Trying my luck."

Wang Siyu said, "Your compositions are so good, you'll definitely win an award." She even waved her fist. "Go for it!"

"Thank you." Chen Guiliang returned her smile.

The atmosphere in the class was quite friendly. The students got along harmoniously, and no one looked down on Chen Guiliang for being poor.

Except for Li Jun!

Bian Guanyue listened to their conversation without any reaction, continuing to memorize English words the entire time.

After chatting with Chen Guiliang for a bit, Wang Siyu curiously asked Bian Guanyue, "Classmate Bian, are you from Rongcheng?"

"Mhm," Bian Guanyue replied with just one word.

But Wang Siyu was an outgoing person. "So, do you board at school or commute?"

Bian Guanyue said, "Commute."

Wang Siyu said, "I live in the Fugui Garden residential complex. Where do you live? If it's on the way, we could go to and from school together."

"I live in the old alleys on Back Street," Bian Guanyue said.

Wang Siyu lamented, "That's not on the way."

Wang Siyu's deskmate, Zheng Feng, had long wanted to talk to Bian Guanyue. Seizing the opportunity, he turned around excitedly. "I live near Back Street. It's a bit unsafe over there at night. I can walk you home after evening self-study."

"No need," Bian Guanyue always refused.

Zheng Feng was a little disappointed, but then he thought that since they didn't live far from each other, they would probably run into each other often in the future, and he secretly cheered up.

When they had switched seats, Bian Guanyue was no longer wearing her hood. Her ponytail had been knocked crooked somehow, and a lock of her fine hair rested on her left shoulder.

Wang Siyu, making herself at home, reached out to touch Bian Guanyue's hair, saying with immense envy, "Your hair is so nice. It's dry and smooth. What shampoo do you use?"

"It's an ion perm. It has nothing to do with the shampoo," Bian Guanyue said.

Wang Siyu asked, "What's an ion perm? Can hair be permed straight?"

Li Jun sidled over furtively. Because he was too tall, it was inconvenient for him to stand during self-study, so he said in a half-squat, "There's a place on Fuzhou Avenue that does ion perms. Business is really good. I heard it's a new technique from overseas."

Zheng Feng, wanting to join the conversation, suppressed his disgust and picked up where Li Jun left off. "I know the one on Fuzhou Avenue. It's called Korean Wave Fashion Hair Salon. My sister got an ion perm there. It's really expensive, and my mom even chewed her out for it."

The three of them discussed beauty and hairstyling, and Bian Guanyue grew annoyed listening to them.

She didn't like being disturbed.

Especially by strangers.

Bian Guanyue pulled up her hood again and tightened the drawstring at the collar of her hoodie, hiding her entire face in the hood, leaving only her eyes and nose visible.

It was a clear sign she didn't want to talk anymore.

Wang Siyu gave an awkward smile, turned back around, and sat properly to read her book.

Zheng Feng hesitated, then also gave up on hitting on the pretty girl.

Only Li Jun was still squatting beside her. "Classmate Bian, where did you buy that Nokia?"

Bian Guanyue didn't make a sound, treating Li Jun like thin air.

Li Jun continued, "I actually want to buy a Nokia too, but your model is sold out. I'll make a trip to Rongcheng later and buy the same one as you."

Bian Guanyue remained silent.

Li Jun felt he was losing face. He stood up, walked behind Chen Guiliang, and clapped him on the shoulder, saying, "Let's switch seats."

"Scram!"

Chen Guiliang's reply was simple and direct.

Li Jun took out some Renminbi. "Ten yuan for your seat."

Chen Guiliang finally deigned to look at him. "Ten yuan? Are you trying to get rid of a beggar?"

"Tch." Li Jun pursed his lips.

Chen Guiliang added, "This seat and I have a deep bond. It'll be at least a hundred yuan."

What the hell kind of deep bond!

Bian Guanyue was speechless listening to this.

She turned her head to look at Chen Guiliang, her eyes filled with disdain, seeing him as a petty, money-grubbing person.

Spending a hundred yuan to buy a seat felt like a total rip-off to Li Jun. But if he could be deskmates with a pretty girl, it seemed any amount of money was worth it.

Li Jun gritted his teeth, took out his wallet, and handed over a hundred-yuan bill, urging repeatedly, "Hurry up and move!"

Chen Guiliang accepted the money with a grin, picked up his desk, and started moving it over.

Li Jun also quickly got busy, fantasizing about the days of being deskmates with a pretty girl. This guy was a few screws short, not at all considering why Bian Guanyue had wanted to switch seats in the first place.

"Ho ho, we're deskmates again," Guan Zhiqiang said with a silly grin to Chen Guiliang, who had just moved over.

This transaction between Chen Guiliang and Li Jun had already attracted the attention of nearby students. Their thoughts were similar to Bian Guanyue's; they all looked down on Chen Guiliang's money-grubbing behavior.

Just then, Chen Guiliang, who had settled into his new seat, smiled and said to Bian Guanyue, "Classmate Bian, aren't you going to switch over?"

Bian Guanyue was fuming inwardly, planning to find someone else to switch seats with tomorrow.

Hearing Chen Guiliang's question, Bian Guanyue was caught off guard by the sudden reversal. Her tense little face relaxed a bit. She picked up her desk and said to Guan Zhiqiang, "Classmate, could you please switch again?"

Guan Zhiqiang was stunned for two seconds. "Huh? Oh, okay."

Seeing Bian Guanyue and Guan Zhiqiang also switching seats, Li Jun was instantly dumbfounded. "Wait… you can't switch. I… I paid a hundred yuan!"

"Excuse me, please don't block the way," Bian Guanyue said.

Afraid of upsetting the pretty girl, Li Jun could only step aside and watch her move her desk.

Guan Zhiqiang carried his desk over, set it down, and gave Li Jun a silly grin. "Ho ho, we're deskmates again."

"Deskmates my ass!" Li Jun cursed under his breath.

Being inexplicably insulted about his mother, a flash of anger crossed Guan Zhiqiang's face, but it quickly faded as he pulled out his novel again with another silly grin.

Damn, this guy's cunning runs deep! I must not make an enemy of him. Li Jun was full of frustration with nowhere to vent. He walked up to Chen Guiliang and held out his hand. "Give me back my money!"

Chen Guiliang asked, "What money?"

Li Jun said, "The hundred yuan for the seat."

Chen Guiliang asked, "Well, did you get the seat?"

Li Jun was furious. "What damn difference is there between getting it and not getting it!"

Chen Guiliang said, "You just need to answer, did you get the seat or not?"

"I f..."

Li Jun was suddenly at a loss for words.

If he answered that he got it, then the transaction was complete, and he would have no legitimate reason to ask for the hundred yuan back.

But he did get it.

"Pfft…"

Hearing the conversation between the two, Bian Guanyue couldn't help but let out a laugh.

She quickly covered her mouth, hiding her face in her hood as she rested her head on the desk. But her shoulders were still shaking slightly; she was obviously trying hard to hold back her laughter.

This new deskmate of hers, Bian Guanyue thought, is really interesting.

Li Jun was about to explode with anger. He grabbed Chen Guiliang's sleeve. "Are you going to give the money back or not?"

Chen Guiliang said calmly, "Classmate Li Jun, please don't be impulsive. Classmate Bian Guanyue just transferred to our class. If she sees classmates fighting on her very first day, what will she think? She'll definitely think this is a bad class, with bad students disrupting the learning atmosphere. She might even apply to transfer to another class."

Li Jun kept hold of Chen Guiliang's sleeve, glaring at him angrily, then glanced at Bian Guanyue, who was stifling her laughter.

Looking around again, he saw that many other students were also trying not to laugh.

He knew he had become a clown.

"Crap!"

Li Jun let go of Chen Guiliang's sleeve, grabbed his own schoolbag, and left, disappearing from the classroom in an instant.

Evening self-study wasn't over yet, but Li Jun couldn't stand to stay any longer, fleeing home as if escaping.

He cared a lot about his pride, but this time he had lost a great deal of face.

Class monitor Li Rui added insult to injury, "Evening self-study isn't over yet. Students, please do not leave early!"

Hearing this, Li Jun ran even faster.

"Hahahaha!"

As soon as Li Jun left, the students in the back rows burst into laughter.

The students in the first few rows, however, didn't know what had happened. Hearing the abrupt laughter, they all turned their heads with confused expressions.

A few minutes later, the bell for the end of evening self-study rang.

Bian Guanyue packed her schoolbag. She took two steps, then stopped, turned around, and asked, "Classmate, what's your name?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Chen Guiliang. Chen as in 'ear east.' Gui as in 'wealthy,' and Liang as in 'kind.'"

That darn name had gone astray.

He was neither wealthy nor kind.

Bian Guanyue introduced herself again. "My name is Bian Guanyue. My dad's surname is Bian, and my mom's is Guan."

(I recommend Ji Cha's "Sacrifice of Mountain and River." If you don't like it, go curse him. If you do, thank me for recommending a good book. Also, please vote with monthly tickets.)
